sections.heading: Tokens & Embeddings
sections.content: Text is split into tokens. Tokens are mapped to vectors (embeddings) that capture semantic relationships.

sections.heading: Attention
sections.content: Transformers use attention to weigh relevant tokens when predicting the next token. Multi‑head attention learns different relationships.

sections.heading: Inference & Context Window
sections.content: The model predicts one token at a time conditioned on prior tokens (prompt + generated). The maximum sequence length is the context window.
